content_parts.title: Data structure refactoring: Purchase receipts and sales shipments

content_parts.content:
To enhance stability, performance, and scalability, node structures are refactored across both purchasing and sales processes.

  • Purchasing: Purchase receipts move to the inbound flow.
  • Sales: Sales shipments are part of the base document structure.

In both cases, date replaces the receiptDate and shipmentDate properties.
For more details, refer to the updated documentation:

  • Purchasing API reference
  • Sales API reference
  • Changelog

content_parts.content:
With workflow automation, you can set one or multiple steps in action on an event that triggers the process. This can include automatically creating or modifying records.

If you have multiple tenants, you can share workflows across tenants by creating an import/export template based on the Workflow node.

You can automate generic actions on any record, such as

  • Running a report
  • Transferring attachments from one record to another
  • Attaching an existing report to a record
  • Sending an email with attachments
  • Notifying a customer
  • Updating a record, including custom fields

You can automate a process specific to the type of record, which simplifies setting up workflow. For now, the following actions apply to sales orders:

  • Confirm order, allocate stock, and create shipment
  • Confirm shipment, post to stock, and create invoice

New processes will be added with each release.

content_parts.title: AP and AR payment tracking: Discounts and penalties

content_parts.content:
Payment tracking provides enhanced support to the accounts payable and accounts receivable process with improved clarity and accuracy for payment reconciliation. The enhancement enables more accurate and flexible handling of payments received or made with discount deductions for early payment, penalty additions for late payment, and other manual adjustments.

When you print a sales invoice, the applicable discount and penalty details are displayed, making it easier to understand payment terms.

If you use Sage Intacct, this functionality is not available.

content_parts.title: Work order variance journals populate with released item dimensions

content_parts.content:
When a work order is completed, all work order variance journals correctly populate with the dimensions of the released item on each line. For users integrated with Sage Intacct Inventory Control, this ensures accurate dimensional tracking and reporting.

This applies to the following movement types:

  • Work order variance
  • Work order negative variance
  • Work order actual cost adjustment (Non-absorbed)
  • Work order negative actual cost adjustment

You can create receipts and payments from the Sales invoice and Purchase invoice pages and their respective Main lists. Payment details display in each Main list, improving visibility and streamlining workflows. If you use Sage Intacct, this functionality is not available.

content_parts.title: Scheduled job to delete old MRP calculation results

content_parts.content:
To automatically remove outdated Material Requirement Planning (MRP) data, a new scheduled job is delivered as part of the setup and starts automatically once a week.

You can modify the job schedule parameters to change the thresholds for minimum age and number of calculation results to keep. If no parameter values are given, which is the default, the scheduled job deletes MRP calculation results older than 14 days while keeping the 30 most recent results.

You can view the stock levels of stock managed items on a work order component line in a graphical format.

Scroll the list of components continuously on the Operations tab to explore results without interruption.

content_parts.title: Quick entry and line panel for stock

content_parts.content:
Improvements for stock documents include receipts, issues, and adjustments.

With quick entry functionality, you can add lines directly in the grid and add to the document by selecting Ctrl + Enter on your MS computer or command + Enter on a Mac.

In the Line panel, you can add multiple lines and scroll through all lines in the document.

content_parts.content:
Tables across the application were updated to make editing data seamless and to improve the display of large datasets.

Instant grid updates
Grids update immediately when you add or remove rows without reloading.

Infinite scrolling for nested grids
The first level of nested grids supports infinite scrolling, allowing data to load seamlessly while you scroll.

Improved tab layout on smaller screens
On pages with a header and tabbed content, tabs that contain tables with infinite scroll or nested grids maintain a minimum height of 480 px. When there isn’t enough space, a scrollbar displays within the tab, so you can access all your content and still collapse the header for more room.
